name: Blooming Conductor
summary:
Blooming Conductor: A Hand-Tracking VR Rhythm Adventure

What if music could make nature bloom?

Step into the next generation of spatial computing with Blooming Conductor, an immersive VR music game where your hands hold the power of creation. Experience a world where every gesture breathes life into the earth.

Leave your controllers behind—this is a pure hand-tracking experience designed for the ultimate freedom of movement on Meta Quest 3, Quest 3S, and Quest Pro.
